chapters.label: The cross
chapters.text: Mexico, 1970. England against Brazil. Carlos Alberto finds Jairzinho on the right. He beats Terry Cooper and crosses from the byline.

chapters.label: The header
chapters.text: Pelé leaps over Alan Mullery and heads it down. He shouts, “Goal!” But Gordon Banks gets there!

chapters.label: The replay
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Banks races across from the near post. The ball bounces up in front of him, and his right hand scoops it over the bar.

chapters.label: The lesson
chapters.text: The save of the century! Keep moving your feet, and never give up on a ball.
